I_ACCESS.description: Users report being unable to sign in because their account credentials are not accepted.

I_BILLING.description: Users object to basic playback controls and listening features being restricted to Premium subscribers.

I_CATALOG.description: Users report missing songs or lyrics and dissatisfaction with music recommendations.

I_DOWNLOADS.description: Users report that offline listening does not work and may consider canceling Premium as a result.

I_OTHER.description: Users express general dissatisfaction with the app and intentions to uninstall without identifying a specific product issue.

I_PLAYBACK.description: Users report launch, loading, connectivity, playback interruption, and audio-control failures.

I_USABILITY.description: Users report excessive advertisements, unwanted random playback, and removal of basic player features.
